Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: What you need to know before getting started.

what.question: What is SAVAN?
what.answer: SAVAN is a web application that helps businesses manage leads, conversations, appointments and follow-ups in one place, with an AI assistant for writing and summarizing.

who.question: Who is SAVAN for?
who.answer: Small and medium-sized businesses that win customers through enquiries, quotes and appointments.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: SAVAN is fully available in English and French. Your team can use the interface in one language while writing to prospects in another.

aiSending.question: Does the AI send messages on its own?
aiSending.answer: No. AI suggestions and automated messages are drafts. They are only marked as sent after a member of your team approves them.

data.question: Who can see my data?
data.answer: Each workspace is isolated: only its members can access its leads and conversations. Prospect details are stored exactly as entered and are never translated automatically.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Plans are billed monthly. Payments are processed by Stripe.

cancel.question: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. You can cancel from the Subscription page of your account. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

integrations.question: Does SAVAN connect to my email or calendar?
integrations.answer: Not yet. Integrations are in development. Today, you record messages in SAVAN and send them from your usual tools.
